translation_basis: Tibetan translation (the Apabhraṃśa/Sanskrit original not consulted); paraphrase made by the unit from the Tibetan
notes: Tōh 2292 names the singer 'g+ho ra kha'. Names Matsyendra (ma tsin+d+hi) explicitly — Tōh 2292 itself links Mīnapa/Matsyendra, Cauraṅgi and Gorakṣa. The word 'ba dzi' in the last line is not understood.
